2607.24731.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
2607.24731.paper_summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) adapts diffusion models by querying a teacher along trajectories generated by the current student, but how it should behave under classifier-free guidance (CFG), a default component of modern diffusion systems, remains poorly understood. Existing OPD methods naturally extend velocity matching to the CFG-composed prediction, directly matching teacher and student guided velocities. We show that this objective is under-identified at the branch level: positive- and negative-branch errors can compensate in the guided prediction. Through two contrasting cases, we find that naive matching remains effective under shared negative conditioning, where both branch errors decrease jointly. When the model's native CFG schema retains privileged information in the teacher's negative branch that is unavailable to the student, however, this joint reduction breaks down and the composed objective induces antagonistic branch-error dynamics, reducing the positive-branch error while increasing the negative-branch error. We term this failure mode Negative Branch Asymmetry (NBA). To address NBA, we introduce Positive--Direction Matching (PDM), a branch-aware OPD objective that separately constrains the positive prediction and the CFG conditional direction. We apply PDM to dense-to-sparse video control, where naive guided matching is highly sensitive to inference guidance scales, while branch-aware supervision enables more robust and effective knowledge transfer.
2607.24731.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）中，通過沿著當前學生生成的軌跡查詢教師來調整擴散模型，但在無分類器指導（CFG）下它應該如何運作，這一點仍然不太清楚，CFG是現代擴散系統的一個默認組件。現有的OPD方法自然地將速度匹配擴展到由CFG組成的預測，直接匹配教師和學生的引導速度。我們表明，這一目標在分支層面上是未被充分識別的：正分支和負分支的錯誤可以在引導預測中相互補償。通過兩個對比案例，我們發現，在共享的負條件下，幼稚的匹配仍然有效，因為兩個分支的錯誤共同減少。然而，當模型的本地CFG架構在教師的負分支中保留了學生無法獲得的特權信息時，這種聯合減少會崩潰，組合目標會引發對抗性的分支錯誤動態，減少正分支錯誤的同時增加負分支錯誤。我們將這種失敗模式稱為負分支不對稱（NBA）。為了解決NBA，我們引入了正向匹配（PDM），這是一個分支感知的OPD目標，分別約束正向預測和CFG條件方向。我們將PDM應用於密集到稀疏的視頻控制，在這裡幼稚的引導匹配對推理引導尺度高度敏感，而分支感知的監督則能夠實現更穩健和有效的知識轉移。
